Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ قُلْتَ فِيْ كِتَابِكَ المُنْزَلِ
Translation: O Allah, You have said in Your revealed Book

Arabic text: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِيْ أُنْزِلَ فِيْهِ القُرْآنُ
Translation: The month of Ramadan in which was revealed the Quran

Arabic text: هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَاتٍ مِنَ الهُدَى وَالفُرْقَانِ
Translation: A guidance for mankind and clear proofs of guidance and the criterion
You have magnified the sanctity of the month of Ramadan
By what You revealed in it of the Quran
And You distinguished it with the Night of Power
And made it better than a thousand months

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَهٰذِهِ أَيَّامُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ قَدِ انْقَضَتْ
Translation: O Allah, the days of the month of Ramadan have passed
And its nights have elapsed

Arabic text: وَقَدْ صِرْتُ يَا إِلٰهِيْ مِنْهُ إِلَى مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي
Translation: And I have reached, O my God, from it to a state which You know better than I do
And You have counted its number more precisely than all creation

Arabic text: فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ المُقَرَّبُوْنَ
Translation: So I ask You by what Your closest angels have asked You
And Your sent prophets
And Your righteous servants

Arabic text: أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: That You send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And that You free my neck from the Fire
And admit me to Paradise by Your mercy
And that You favor me with Your pardon and generosity
And accept my drawing near to You
And answer my prayer
And grant me security on the Day of Fear

Arabic text: مِنْ كُلِّ هَوْلٍ أَعْدَدْتَهُ لِيَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ
Translation: From every terror You have prepared for the Day of Resurrection
My God, I seek refuge in Your Noble Face
And in Your Great Majesty

Arabic text: أَنْ يَّنْقَضِيَ أَيَّامُ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ وَلَيَالِيْهِ
Translation: That the days and nights of the month of Ramadan should end

Arabic text: وَلَكَ قِبَلِيْ تَبِعَةٌ أَوْ ذَنْبٌ تُؤَاخِذُنِيْ بِهِ
Translation: While I still have a responsibility or sin for which You will hold me accountable

Arabic text: أَوْ خَطِيْئَةٌ تُرِيْدُ أَنْ تَقْتَصَّهَا مِنِّيْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْهَا لِي
Translation: Or a mistake that You want to exact from me which You have not forgiven me
My Master, my Master, my Master

Arabic text: أَسْأَلُكَ يَا لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
Translation: I ask You, O there is no god but You
Since there is no god but You

Arabic text: إِنْ كُنْتَ رَضِيْتَ عَنِّيْ فِيْ هٰذَا الشَّهْرِ
Translation: If You have been pleased with me in this month
Then increase Your pleasure with me
And if You have not been pleased with me
Then from now be pleased with me
O Most Merciful of the merciful

Arabic text: يَا اَللَّهُ يَا أَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ
Translation: O Allah, O One, O Eternal

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُوْلَدْ
Translation: O He who begets not, nor was He begotten
And there is none like unto Him

Arabic text: يَا مُلَيِّنَ الحَدِيْدِ لِدَاوُدَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ
Translation: O Softener of iron for David, peace be upon him

Arabic text: يَا كَاشِفَ الضُّرِّ وَالكُرَبِ العِظَامِ عَنْ أَيُّوْبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ
Translation: O Remover of harm and great afflictions from Job, peace be upon him

Arabic text: أَيْ مُفَرِّجَ هَمِّ يَعْقُوْبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ
Translation: O Reliever of the sorrow of Jacob, peace be upon him

Arabic text: أَيْ مُنَفِّسَ غَمِّ يُوْسُفَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ
Translation: O Dispeller of the grief of Joseph, peace be upon him

Arabic text: صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: كَمَا أَنْتَ أَهْلُهُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِيْنَ
Translation: As You are worthy to send blessings upon them all
And do with me what You are worthy of doing

Arabic text: وَلَا تَفْعَلْ بِيْ مَا أَنَا أَهْلُهُ
Translation: And do not do with me what I am worthy of
